data.name: Marzuqah
data.gender_notes: Marzuqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘arzaqa’ which means ‘to provide’, ‘to feed’, or ‘to nourish’. Marzuqah is a name given to a girl who is cherished, cared for, and looked after. The name Marzuqah carries the meaning “Provided for, nourished” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marzuqah usually hope their child will grow to embody provided for, nourished and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the nourishment and care given by Allah (swt) and parents in the growth and development of a child.
